periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with an inward tilt toward the muzzle at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical-oval geometry where the vertical axis is significantly longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering that extends the black plumage significantly below the geometric midpoint of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thickness at the visible left lateral flank occupies approximately 50% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant inter-ear gap, roughly equivalent to the total width of the cranial vault between the ears.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the superior boundary of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced serrated or spiky texture of the white fur along the lower mandible and ventral neck area.
